Assessment: When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis. Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first-line treatment for primary CM of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ. Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness. [aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-excision-first-line]
